title: 第一卷 第3章 捡到一个破陶罐第一卷 第4章 过分自信的大姐
content_zh:
咣当！
柴房的门被推开。
“陈玄，出来！”
晨曦穿过门框洒进柴房，映出一道魁梧的身影。
陈玄迷迷糊糊睁开眼，揉了揉发酸的眼睛，站起来看了眼张头儿，跟着他走出柴房，心中越发忐忑。
出了柴房，张头儿从怀中取出一个瓷瓶丢给陈玄，“事情结果出来了，跟你没关系，昨天是我错怪你了，这瓶金疮药就当补偿。”
陈玄紧绷的心弦顿时放松，不由摸了摸胸膛顺顺气。
张头儿没好气道，“回去了赶紧敷一敷伤口，别耽搁了今天的活！”
刚准备感动一下的陈玄立马黑了脸。
伤成这样还要干活？
这是根本没把他当人，生产队的驴子都不敢这样使唤。
“那个……张头儿，我都这样了，要不就让我休息两天吧，我自己倒是无所谓，主要是怕耽搁了活计连累到你。”陈玄还想争取一下。
每个杂役都有自己的活计，要是干不完，张头儿作为管事的，也免不了上头一番训诫。
“你个狗崽子还敢跟我提条件？”
张头儿扬起鞭子作势要打，但看到陈玄身上的血痕，还是收起鞭子，“我不管你伤成什么样，今天的活儿干不完，山下乱坟岗就是你的归宿！”
说完，甩手离去。
陈玄恨得牙痒痒，却又无可奈何。
寄人屋檐下，不得不低头！
暗中咒骂张头儿一番，一瘸一拐地回到柴房，捡起锄头朝山下走去。
他每天的任务是锄地。

灵药峰种植各种灵药，用来提供给诸位仙长老爷炼制仙丹。
山腰以下被开发成梯田，约有二十亩地已经栽种灵药，还有十几亩未开发地，陈玄要做的就是挥着锄头，面朝黄土背朝天，将未开发的地锄一遍。
要他说根本就是折磨人。
都说是仙门了，无外乎就是上仙老爷一挥袖子施个法的事儿，结果还要杂役用人力来锄，好歹给头牛、给个犁也成啊！
陈玄严重怀疑这些山上仙师都有些变态心理，喜欢玩弄杂役弟子。
抱怨归抱怨，却也无可奈何，谁叫他修行资质差，只能进这杂役院呢，真是应了那句，混得好不好，全看出身吊不吊。
陈玄使劲挥舞锄头，化悲愤为力量，将气全撒在了地里。
每挥一锄头，就小声骂一句，“该死的张狗！”
一直锄到中午，太阳高挂头顶。
他擦去额头上的汗水，肚子传来“咕咕”的抗议声。
人是铁饭是钢，陈玄扛着锄头回了杂役院，走到自己小屋取来碗筷，飞奔向伙房。
抢饭的事儿必须得积极，去得晚了怕连口汤都混不上。
顾不上身上传来的疼痛感，一股脑挤进人群，将碗伸到盛饭的大叔面前，“刘叔，多来点肉！”
刘大叔抬起头刚想骂，见他满是伤痕，不由心生怜悯，接过碗盛了满满一碗，递回给他。
“谢了，刘叔！”陈玄端着碗挤出人群。
刘大叔低下头继续打饭，心中却是叹息：都是些十四五的孩子啊，跑来遭这罪……
陈玄端着碗蹲在台阶上狼吞虎咽。
张头儿背着手走过来，低头看了眼，说道，“陈玄呐，多吃点，吃饱了才有力气干活！”
“谢头儿关心。”陈玄含糊不清地应了声。
见他走进门，才敢回过头做个鬼脸。

什么东西！
吃完饭刷了碗，陈玄顾不上休息，扛起锄头快步朝山下跑去。
扶着腰在地里缓了片刻，揉了揉酸痛的肩膀，又挥起锄头。
“该死的张狗！”
……
content_en:
Bang!
The woodshed door was pushed open.
"Chen Xuan, come out!"
The morning light shines through the door frame into the woodshed, reflecting a burly figure.
Chen Xuan opened his eyes in a daze, rubbed his sore eyes, stood up and glanced at Zhang Tou'er, followed him out of the woodshed, feeling increasingly uneasy.
After leaving the woodshed, Zhang Tou'er took out a porcelain bottle from his arms and threw it to Chen Xuan, "The outcome of the matter has nothing to do with you. I wrongly blamed you yesterday, and this bottle of golden sore medicine will be used as compensation."
Chen Xuan's tense heartstrings suddenly relaxed, and he couldn't help but touch his chest to calm down.
Zhang Tou'er said angrily, "Hurry up and apply the wound when you get back. Don't delay today's work!"
Chen Xuan, who was just about to be moved, immediately turned dark.
Do you still have to work with such an injury?
This is not treating him as a human being at all. Even the donkeys in the production team dare not use him like this.
"Well... Boss Zhang, I'm already like this. Why don't you just let me rest for two days? I don't care. I'm mainly afraid that it will delay my work and affect you." Chen Xuan still wanted to fight for it.
Each handyman has his own work. If he fails to finish it, as the manager, Zhang Tou'er will inevitably be reprimanded by his superiors.
"How dare you make terms with me, you little bastard?"
Zhang Tou'er raised his whip as if to hit him, but when he saw the blood stains on Chen Xuan's body, he put away the whip and said, "I don't care how injured you are. If you can't finish today's work, the graveyard at the foot of the mountain will be your destination!"
After saying that, he waved his hands and left.
Chen Xuan was itching his teeth with hatred, but he was helpless.
Living under someone else's roof, you have to bow your head!
Cursing Zhang Tou'er secretly, he limped back to the woodshed, picked up the hoe and walked down the mountain.
His daily task is to hoe the ground.
Various elixirs are planted in the elixir peak to provide them to the immortal elders to refine elixirs.
The lower part of the mountainside has been developed into terraced fields. About twenty acres of land have been planted with elixirs, and there are still more than ten acres of undeveloped land. All Chen Xuan has to do is to hoe the undeveloped land with a hoe, facing the loess and turning his back to the sky.
He said it was simply torture.
They say it’s an immortal sect, but it’s just a matter of the immortal master waving his sleeves and casting a spell. In the end, the handyman has to use manpower to hoe, so it’s okay to just give him an ox and a plow!
Chen Xuan seriously suspected that these mountain immortal masters had some abnormal psychology and liked to play tricks on the handyman disciples.
Complaining is a complaint, but there is nothing he can do about it. Who told him that his cultivation qualifications are poor and he can only enter this handyman's courtyard? It is true to that sentence. Whether he gets along well or not depends entirely on whether he is born or not.
Chen Xuan swung his hoe vigorously, turning his grief and anger into strength, and vented all his energy into the ground.
Every time he swung the hoe, he cursed under his breath, "Damn Zhang Gou!"
I kept hoeing until noon, with the sun high above my head.
He wiped the sweat from his forehead and heard a growl of protest from his stomach.
People are like rice and steel. Chen Xuan returned to the handyman's yard with his hoe, walked to his hut to get the bowls and chopsticks, and rushed to the kitchen.
You have to be active in grabbing food. If you arrive late, you might not even be able to get some soup.
Ignoring the pain in my body, I squeezed into the crowd and stretched my bowl in front of the uncle holding the rice, "Uncle Liu, please give me more meat!"
Uncle Liu raised his head and was about to scold him, but when he saw that he was covered with scars, he couldn't help but feel pity. He took the bowl, filled it up, and handed it back to him.
"Thanks, Uncle Liu!" Chen Xuan squeezed out of the crowd with a bowl in hand.
Uncle Liu lowered his head and continued to cook, but he sighed in his heart: These are children of the 14th and 15th Five-Year Plans, who came here to suffer this...
Chen Xuan squatted on the steps with a bowl and devoured it.
Zhang Tou'er walked over with his hands behind his back, looked down and said, "Chen Xuan, eat more. Only when you are full can you have the strength to work!"
"Thank you for your concern, boss." Chen Xuan responded vaguely.
When she saw him walking in the door, she dared to turn around and make a face.
What!
After finishing the meal and washing the dishes, Chen Xuan didn't bother to rest, picked up the hoe and ran quickly down the mountain.
He held his waist and rested in the ground for a moment, rubbed his sore shoulders, and then swung the hoe again.
"Damn Zhangdog! "
